utility: Half exact canonical policy accuracy plus half exact composed status/value/full-trace accuracy over eight fixed programs and four event probes.
credit: Post-update task utility minus counterfactual utility with that cell's adapter restored to its pre-fit state; routing remains fixed. Record routing-only counterfactual separately. These conditional contributions need not add up.
pruning: Expand to rank 8, then greedily remove channels using current training-prefix task utility until rank 2. Charge every selection evaluation. The parameter limit is an equal upper bound; actual retained parameters deliberately differ.
budget: One shared process, one CPU, shared frozen head and precomputed encoder vectors. Charge setup equally, and per arm charge initialization, route/prune selection, optimization, credit diagnostics, checkpoint persistence, reload and held evaluation. Any measured total above the allowance is budget-invalid, not a fair-budget success. Final report serialization and process startup are recorded separately; exact entire-research cost is not claimed.
evaluation: Reuse the published held expressions only after all arms finish training. This is exploratory reuse, not a fresh blind test. No acceptance rule or hyperparameter is selected on held outcomes.
admission: No automatic split or prune activation. Report quality, retention and actual cost, including failures. A budget-invalid or failed arm cannot establish superiority.
scope: Existing finite eight-address parameter-memory study. No native owner, autonomous recursive growth, new-entity generalization or general-agent claim. Existing parent training/encoder assets are sunk costs, recorded as shared prerequisites, not zero-cost training.
